nom: Glycolic Acid Pads 20%: Dual Sided Exfoliating Face Peels with Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Reduce Surface Skin Fine Lin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the pads help control oil production, leaving pores looking cleaner and skin less oily, with the salicylic acid content specifically recommended for oil and acne concerns.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers report the pads work well on sensitive skin, citing little to no fragrance and no issues with redness or purging, with one suggesting sensitive skin may do best using the pads a few times a week rather than daily.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes the pads as great for normal skin, noting little to no fragrance and no redness or purging issues.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports her forehead fine lines became less noticeable within a few weeks of regular use and describes the pads as effective for improving texture, reducing dullness, and addressing early signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers note the acid can leave skin feeling slightly dry immediately after use and recommend moisturizing afterward, though none report ongoing dryness or irritation when a moisturizer is used alongside the pads.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report no redness or irritation from the pads, including one who specifically notes zero issues with redness or purging despite regular use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the pads helped eliminate flaking and peeling and left skin feeling smoother and softer immediately after use.
concerns.spots: Reports on dark spots are mixed: one reviewer says the pads did not visibly fade dark spots as expected, while another describes skin looking brighter and more even-toned after regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as oily or acne-prone report the salicylic acid content helps keep skin clearer and more breakout-free, and the pads are specifically recommended for those dealing with oil and acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads help control oil production, leaving skin feeling less oily and more balanced after use.

extraits.texte: These saturated pads are a powerful blend of glycolic acid, salicylic acid, tea tree oil, niacinamide, centella asiatica, and vitamin C. This combination offers excellent exfoliation and toning benefits. Glycolic and salicylic acids promote skin cell turnover and deeply cleanse pores, helping to refine skin texture. They're particularly effective for oily and acne-prone skin. Tea tree oil provides antimicrobial properties, while vitamin C and niacinamide work together to brighten the complexion. These are all powerhouse ingredients in skincare. I recommend following up with a good moisturizer and sunscreen, especially if you're using these in your morning routine. Personally, I use these pads in the morning because I reserve stronger actives for nighttime. They help control oil production and have kept my skin clearer and more breakout-free. I've also noticed a brighter, more radiant complexion since using them, as well as an improvement in skin texture. I'm well-conditioned to these ingredients, so I haven't experienced any irritation. However, if you're new to acids or active ingredients, I suggest starting slowly and making sure to moisturize well to minimize any potential dryness or sensitivity.

I’ve been using these glycolic acid pads for a few weeks, and they’ve quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The dual-sided design is great, one side has a textured surface that gives a gentle exfoliation, while the smooth side is perfect for wiping across more sensitive areas. I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter, smoother, and more even-toned, and the fine lines around my forehead are already less noticeable. I really like that these pads also contain salicylic acid to help with breakouts and niacinamide for calming and hydration. They give me that “just had a facial” glow without the expense of a spa visit. The 20% glycolic acid is strong, so I recommend starting slowly if you’ve never used acids before, but my skin tolerated it well when paired with a good moisturizer. These are a fantastic option for anyone looking to improve skin texture, reduce dullness, or fight early signs of aging. Definitely worth it!

I love the entire design of this product! From the flip top to the included tweezers to keep the pads sanitary and fresh. The skin feel is out of this world immediately makes your skin smoother/softer while getting rid of any flaking or peeling you may have. Great for people with normal or sensitive skin as the pads have little to no fragrance, I've had zero issues with redness or any kind of purging. Overall, the pads are a great quality that's super effective for addressing a variety of skin concerns.

For me, these glycolic acid pads feel really convenient for daily skincare. The double-sided texture is easy to use—the rough side gently exfoliates without irritation, and the smooth side leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. I’ve noticed my pores look cleaner and my skin feels less oily after using them, and the combination of tea tree and centella asiatica makes it soothing for sensitive areas. It’s a simple addition to my routine that keeps my face looking balanced and healthy.

extraits.titre: Best for beginners or people with oil/acne problems
extraits.texte: These glycolic acid pads are just OK. I don’t really think they are a strength of 20%. I use and I’ve tried quite a lot of chemical exfoliants and of course glycolic acid is a popular one that can work very well if you get one that’s good quality. The one that I typically use is strong and pretty fantastic, and by comparison this one is a bit weak, although not entirely unuseful. This is something that I might carry with me while traveling or on the go, etc. if I need something quick and easy because my typical process is more complicated than just pulling out a single wipe and swiping it across my face. So this is useful if you still want to stay in line with your usual routine, but do need more ease. The pads themselves are alright but are a little on the thin side so can be hard to hold. I do prefer something more substantial. And the scent of this isn’t something that bothers me. I’m sure for someone that has sensitive skin this might be a good product for you to use regularly like three times a week or so if your skin can’t stand a stronger product. But honestly I don’t really see a huge difference in my skin using this product. It does have salicylic acid in it too which will be great for people that have more problems with oil and acne. So I would recommend it for them. This product may be worth a try, depending on your skin type, sensitivity, and needs. I do hope this review is helpful and you have a fantastic day!
